task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First step, move north. Then, retrieve the whisk from the platter. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
description:
You arrive in an office. An usual one. Okay, just remember what you're here to do, and everything will go great.

You can see a table. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of trash. Hm. Oh well

There is an open door leading west. There is an unguarded exit to the north. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

thought: I should move north as the first step of the instructions.
feedback:
You find yourself in a dish-pit. A standard kind of place.

Oh, great. Here's a platter. You see a whisk on the platter.

There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unguarded.
